<SW.Blocks.CompileUnit ID="2" CompositionName="CompileUnits">
  <AttributeList>
    <NetworkSource><FlgNet xmlns="http://www.siemens.com/automation/Openness/SW/NetworkSource/FlgNet/v4">
      <Parts>
        <!-- 分支1：停机清零 -->
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="101"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机运行按" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="LiteralConstant" UId="102"><Constant><ConstantType>Real</ConstantType><ConstantValue>0.0</ConstantValue></Constant></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="103"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机控制输出" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Part Name="Contact" UId="110"><Negated Name="operand" /></Part>
        <Part Name="Move" UId="111"><TemplateValue Name="Card" Type="Cardinality">1</TemplateValue></Part>
        <!-- 分支2：计算链 -->
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="201"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机运行按" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="202"><Symbol><Component Name="信号数据" /><Component Name="风机控制输出" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="LiteralConstant" UId="203"><Constant><ConstantType>Real</ConstantType><ConstantValue>100.0</ConstantValue></Constant></Access>
        <Access Scope="LiteralConstant" UId="204"><Constant><ConstantType>Real</ConstantType><ConstantValue>27648.0</ConstantValue></Constant></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="205"><Symbol><Component Name="内部数据" /><Component Name="风机控制输出值" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="206"><Symbol><Component Name="内部数据" /><Component Name="风压过渡" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Access Scope="GlobalVariable" UId="207"><Symbol><Component Name="风机控制" /></Symbol></Access>
        <Part Name="Contact" UId="210" />
        <Part Name="Calc" UId="211"><Equation>(IN1/IN2)*IN3</Equation><TemplateValue Name="Card" Type="Cardinality">3</TemplateValue><TemplateValue Name="SrcType" Type="Type">Real</TemplateValue></Part>
        <Part Name="Convert" UId="212"><TemplateValue Name="SrcType" Type="Type">Real</TemplateValue><TemplateValue Name="DestType" Type="Type">Int</TemplateValue></Part>
        <Part Name="Move" UId="213"><TemplateValue Name="Card" Type="Cardinality">1</TemplateValue></Part>
      </Parts>
      <Wires>
        <!-- Powerrail分叉到2个分支 -->
        <Wire UId="120"><Powerrail /><NameCon UId="110" Name="in" /><NameCon UId="210" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <!-- 分支1：停机清零 -->
        <Wire UId="121"><IdentCon UId="101" /><NameCon UId="110" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="122"><NameCon UId="110" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="111" Name="en" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="123"><IdentCon UId="102" /><NameCon UId="111" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="124"><NameCon UId="111" Name="out1" /><IdentCon UId="103" /></Wire>
        <!-- 分支2：计算链 -->
        <Wire UId="221"><IdentCon UId="201" /><NameCon UId="210" Name="operand" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="222"><NameCon UId="210" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="211" Name="en" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="223"><IdentCon UId="202" /><NameCon UId="211" Name="in1" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="224"><IdentCon UId="203" /><NameCon UId="211" Name="in2" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="225"><IdentCon UId="204" /><NameCon UId="211" Name="in3" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="226"><NameCon UId="211" Name="out" /><NameCon UId="212" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="227"><NameCon UId="211" Name="eno" /><NameCon UId="212" Name="en" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="228"><NameCon UId="212" Name="out" /><IdentCon UId="205" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="229"><NameCon UId="212" Name="eno" /><NameCon UId="213" Name="en" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="230"><IdentCon UId="206" /><NameCon UId="213" Name="in" /></Wire>
        <Wire UId="231"><NameCon UId="213" Name="out1" /><IdentCon UId="207" /></Wire>
      </Wires>
    </FlgNet></NetworkSource>
    <ProgrammingLanguage>LAD</ProgrammingLanguage>
  </AttributeList>
  <ObjectList>
    <MultilingualText ID="4" CompositionName="Comment"><ObjectList><MultilingualTextItem ID="5" CompositionName="Items"><AttributeList><Culture>zh-CN</Culture><Text>停机清零、百分比换算和模拟量输出转换</Text></AttributeList></MultilingualTextItem></ObjectList></MultilingualText>
    <MultilingualText ID="6" CompositionName="Title"><ObjectList><MultilingualTextItem ID="7" CompositionName="Items"><AttributeList><Culture>zh-CN</Culture><Text>风机输出计算</Text></AttributeList></MultilingualTextItem></ObjectList></MultilingualText>
  </ObjectList>
</SW.Blocks.CompileUnit>
